global_organization_chain: Summary Sheet: A six-move summary ending in four short- and long-run offices. -> The introduction motivates language utility and separates native from non-native mechanisms.
Introduction and model orientation: A bounded temporal-distribution problem and two-state analytical split. -> Assumptions and notation define the modeled population and variables.
General and model-specific assumptions: A ledger of the conditions under which later recurrences are interpreted. -> Notation and data definitions instantiate the assumed states.
Variables and state notation: A typed symbol ledger spanning all three models. -> Data preprocessing supplies the quantities behind those symbols.
Indicator and panel construction: Four principal components and inputs for temporal and spatial models. -> Short-term models consume the reduced indicators and speaker series.
PCA, AR, cointegration, and ECM: AR(1) native forecasts and an ECM for non-native increments. -> Growing recursive error and data demand motivate a long-run replacement.
Long-term differential system: A parameterized long-run trajectory and local stability analysis. -> Calibration produces fifty-year language forecasts.
Forecast and office results: Forecast tables, geographic conclusions, and initial six-office plans. -> Sensitivity, cross-model checks, and density pruning test those outputs.
Coefficient and initial-value sensitivity: Local sensitivity tables and a bounded fifty-year stability claim. -> Stochastic recurrence tests random disturbances next.
Monte Carlo and cross-model comparison: Reported fluctuation bands and a sparse ANOVA-based agreement claim. -> The geographic outputs feed office-location criteria.
Migration, geography, clustering, MODM, and MINE: Country-language surfaces, ranked capitals, and a pruned four-office plan. -> Conclusions interpret the selected cities and tradeoffs.
Distributed conclusions: A coherent set of language and office recommendations. -> The assessment chapter separates design benefits from limitations.
Model assessments: A benefit-burden ledger tied to model components. -> The improvement subsection proposes dynamic simulation and richer regional data.
Improvements: Two repair directions with explicit target mechanisms. -> The memo then communicates the current, not hypothetical, recommendations.
COO memo: An executive results-and-recommendations brief. -> Appendices retain supporting diagnostics, data, matrices, and forecast-error derivations.
Appendix forecast-error derivation: A geometric forecast-error variance argument and its plotted growth. -> The warning pass checks the duplicated two- and three-step variance expressions.

handoff: [ABS Summary Sheet] The introduction motivates language utility and separates native from non-native mechanisms.

main_argument_chains.claim: Language evolution and office placement are treated as one forecast-to-decision pipeline.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Every city recommendation must retain a trace to the horizon-specific language, migration, economic, and overlap inputs.

main_argument_chains.claim: The short-run temporal model separates native persistence from externally driven non-native change.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Keep the entity split and use each recurrence only for the horizon supported by its diagnostics.

main_argument_chains.claim: Growing AR forecast error and data demands motivate a long-run differential replacement.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat the logistic-plus-linear route as a structural scenario until capacities and L2 mechanisms are independently calibrated.

main_argument_chains.claim: Sensitivity and Monte Carlo are used to bound selected parameter and disturbance concerns before geographic projection.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not upgrade these local checks to joint robustness or calibrated prediction intervals.

main_argument_chains.claim: Country migration and natural growth are converted into language geography through the H matrix.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Audit stochastic direction, growth units, H updates, overlap semantics, and spatial validation before using the surface downstream.

main_argument_chains.claim: The office model discretizes four country features and combines them through fuzzy multi-objective scoring.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Require reproducible scaling, stakeholder weights, cut stability, costs, and feasibility before acting on the rank order.

main_argument_chains.claim: A separate spatial concentration diagnostic prunes each six-city portfolio to four cities.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Tie each removal to measured service loss and operating savings rather than concentration alone.

warnings.warning: Equation (1) reports a PCA reduction but omits a frozen standardization, missing-data, loading, and weighting ledger needed to reproduce 87.6 percent.
Equation (3) is used as AR(1) even though several reported phi estimates exceed one; long-horizon stationarity and recursive-error conditions are therefore not satisfied.
Appendix 5 prints the same variance after the two- and three-step expansions, while the visible three-step error contains an additional phi-squared innovation term.
Equation (7)'s cointegrating relation is estimated from a very short six-language panel without a documented deterministic-term, lag, or multiple-testing design.
Equation (12) does not archive the exact residual series, lag timing, standard errors, or sign convention needed to reproduce the ECM correction.
Equation (13) replaces the unstable AR route with logistic growth, but the source does not estimate or test the fixed carrying capacity mechanism.
Equation (15) assumes a constant annual L2 increment from a fifteen-year average, creating an unbounded linear long-run component without uncertainty.
